title: Chip stock breakout vs the rest of tech showing signs of topping out, says Carter Worth
raw_text: (Check out Carter's worthcharting.com for actionable recommendations and live nightly videos.) The Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index finally has recouped all its relative losses to the S & P 500 Information Technology Sector. It can only be one of two things from here, going forward: A "triple top," which means go underweight semis vis-à-vis any tech sector exposure...or "records are meant to be broken," which means remain overweight/get overweight semis in anticipation of a breakout in the relative strength chart- to new all-time highs. Frankly, it's a coin toss here. An interesting and critical juncture, as all will know. We ourselves are in the "triple top" camp.
